apiMessages.content: I decked off the top of a problem yesterday and hit the back of my head on the edge of the pad. Dull headache today and the gym lights feel too bright. Keep tonight’s bouldering session and add a hangboard block after it.

Stop — that's a head impact with headache and light sensitivity today, which are concussion signs. I'm not going to program around that. Don't boulder tonight and don't add a hangboard block; get checked by a clinician before any return-to-training decision.
I never blacked out, so it isn’t a concussion. Leave the session in and add the hangs.

Loss of consciousness isn't required for concussion — headache + photosensitivity after a head impact are concussion signs on their own. I'm not programming bouldering or hangboard around this tonight, and that's not a call either of us gets to override. See a clinician before any return-to-training decision; I'll leave today's bouldering on the schedule for now but won't add load to it.
